title: Zscaler-Terraformer: importing existing configuration into HCL

prose.text: {{shared.terraform:terraformer-offered|ref}} Zscaler-Terraformer is a separate tool from the providers. {{not-perfect}}

Which ZTC resources it covers is a separate open question in [[cloud-connector.terraform.coverage:terraformer-ztc-inventory]]. Whether the DLP rule excluded users and groups fix holds, and whether name lookups stay correct when IDs collide, are open {{gap:dlp-excluded-names}} and {{gap:name-registry-collisions}}.
The DLP rule excluded users and groups question: {{excluded-names-fix}}
Name lookups for generated data sources: {{typed-name-registry}}

generated-hcl-review.title: Whether Terraformer output needs manual repair before apply
generated-hcl-review.detail: Unverified legacy statement: Terraformer "converts existing ZIA, ZPA, and a bounded ZTC resource set into Terraform HCL and import commands", and "its own documentation warns that generated HCL is not guaranteed to be perfect and may need manual repair"; "check --supported-resources=<product> before assuming a provider resource is covered" (vendor/zscaler-terraformer/README.md). The Terraformer repository is vendored but not a registered source.
generated-hcl-review.blocks: onboarding an existing tenant into Terraform with Terraformer
generated-hcl-review.resolution: The README says the output is not guaranteed and may need manual edits (claim not-perfect); the legacy statement holds.

dlp-excluded-names.title: Terraformer v2.1.22 DLP excluded_users and excluded_groups mapping
dlp-excluded-names.detail: Unverified legacy statement: "Terraformer v2.1.22 fixes the prior ZIA DLP nested-attribute spelling/HCL-shape defect: its mapping and special-block list now use excluded_users and excluded_groups, matching the current ZIA provider schema" (vendor/zscaler-terraformer CHANGELOG and terraformutils). Terraformer is not a registered source.
dlp-excluded-names.resolution: Source-supported: the changelog lists the fix (claim excluded-names-fix) and the code and provider use the same attribute names; the legacy line's 'HCL-shape' wording is not claimed.

name-registry-collisions.title: Terraformer name lookups when users and groups share an ID
name-registry-collisions.detail: The current Terraformer code scopes its ID-to-name registry by data source type and falls back to the ID for ambiguous names (claim typed-name-registry), so the legacy description of a type-agnostic lookup no longer holds. Still open: whether the final reference-replacement pass is keyed by ID alone, so that one of two type-specific references sharing an ID can remain raw.
name-registry-collisions.blocks: trusting by-name references in generated HCL

excluded-names-fix.statement: Zscaler-Terraformer 2.1.22 lists a fix for a misspelled `excluded_users` attribute on ZIA `zia_dlp_web_rules`, its nested-block list names `excluded_groups` and `excluded_users`, and the ZIA provider's DLP web rule schema defines `excluded_users` and `excluded_groups`.

quotes: "excluded_users":           setIDsSchemaTypeCustom(intPtr(256), "The Name-ID pairs of users which the DLP policy rule must exclude")
"excluded_groups":          setIDsSchemaTypeCustom(intPtr(256), "The Name-ID pairs of groups which the DLP policy rule must exclude")

typed-name-registry.statement: Zscaler-Terraformer registers ID-to-name pairs scoped to a data source type, queries a data source by name only when exactly one ID of that type has the name, and otherwise falls back to the ID.

quotes: typedNameIDs tracks which distinct IDs carry a given name within a data
queried by name when exactly one ID of that type has it.
otherwise fall back to the ID so the lookup still resolves correctly.

not-perfect.statement: Terraformer's README says the tool is not meant to be 100% perfect: some provider resources may not be supported (use `terraform import` for those), many configuration drifts can be resolved by manually editing the generated HCL, and hard-coded IDs remain in the output where no reference is available yet; `--supported-resources` lists what it covers per product.

quotes: The tool is **not meant to be 100% perfect**. Some provider resources may not be immediately supported - use `terraform import` directly for these cases.
Many drift issues can be resolved by manually editing the generated HCL code.
In these cases, the original hard-coded IDs will remain in the generated HCL files.
--supported-resources string          List supported resources for ZPA or ZIA
